raw_segments.text: Terence Orion heard him, and straightway brought him a crystal cup full of the foamy ebon ale,
which the noble twin brothers Bungavig and Bungardalon brew ever in their divine alevets,
cunning as the sons of deathless Leda.
For they garner the succulent berries of the hop and mass and sift and brews and brew them,
and they mix therewith sour juices, and bring the must to the sacred fire and cease not
night or day from their toil, those cunning brothers, lords of the vat.
